name: Chaosdramon
main_effect:
Your [Machinedramon] can digivolve into this card in your hand for a memory cost of 1, ignoring this card's digivolution requirements.
[When Digivolving] You may place 1 red or black level 5 card with the [Cyborg] trait from your hand or trash on top of this card's digivolution cards to delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less for each level 5 card with the [Cyborg] trait in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
set_name: Tamer's Selection Box DC-1 Grand Prix 2022
